title: Known bounded positive amplitude profiles preserve orbit localization

localization.profile_hypothesis: Known weights satisfy 0<rho_-<=rho_(N,k)<=rho_+ and t_(N,k)<=1-epsilon on the complete cube, with fixed eta,rho_-,rho_+,epsilon.
localization.normalization: Multiplication by conjugate(c_k) and division by sqrt(rho_k) produce the K1653 channel with constant nonzero signal amplitude and circular Gaussian noise variances uniformly bounded above and below.
localization.risk: Translation risk is O(d_N^(-1)), global-phase risk is O(N^2/d_N)=O(N^(-1)), and normalized per-mode orbit prediction risk is O(N^(-1)).
localization.score_saturation: Bounded score weights and posterior optimality give M_(F,N)=O_(g,eta,rho_-,rho_+,epsilon)(N^3) and R_(Omega,N)/4=C_(F,N)-O(N^3).
localization.scope_guard: A vanishing profile floor, sparse support, unknown profile, growing latent dimension or non-orbit dependence is not covered.
